title: Venturi Space / Astrolab FLIP intro: 180 hours of nights under -180 C. Not watt-hours. Not Cataldo 354 h.
quote: Our batteries and hyper-deformable wheels can withstand temperature variations of more than 300°C, aggressive solar radiation, and 180 hours of nights under -180°C.
note: 180 h is a survival-duration sentence on batteries/wheels. It is not a printed store Wh and not a Mons Mouton night length. Do not replace 354 h with 180 h.
